the development of a communication protocol and its application to the simulation of machine tools.

a standardization of communication in distributed simulation of machine tools.

the use of standardized communication protocols for machine tool simulations enables a more efficient development process.

the use of standardized communication protocols for simulation models enables the development of modular simulation components that can be easily exchanged and reused.
